shuffled_binding_totalization.fixed_fields: origin i keeps its own cue identity, anchor state, numeric actions, action tokens, goal, schema lookup, and ordinary M10 OriginRecallAuditV5; audits are never rotated or replaced
shuffled_binding_totalization.forbidden_grouping: truth identity, target ledger identity, evaluator fingerprint, reward, future, outcome, accepted subset, or any evaluator-only label
